main.description: Promote a checkpoint to a serving alias. Writes a new edge_training_promoted_to row with status='active' and retires any prior active edge for the same alias (sets status='retired'). The serving side (Murakumo / RunPod / Vultr GPU pod) reads mv_training_active_serving to pick up the change.

servingTarget.description: Hint for the serving system. e.g. 'murakumo' / 'runpod' / 'vultr-gpu' / 'browser-ameno'.

promotedBy.description: DID of the actor doing the promotion. Defaults to the caller.

retiredEdgeId.description: Edge ID of the previous active promotion that was retired, if any.
